notes.title: Cats in Time from Pine Studio is out!
notes.notes:
[b] Cats in Time[/b] is a relaxing puzzle game where you explore 3D dioramas, solve puzzles, and save cats lost in time. The game is a cute mix of room escape and hidden object games, but with cats! 

[h1][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/?utm_source=hiddenpaws]Cats in Time by Pine Studio - go save some cats![/url][/b][/h1]

The main goal of every level is to find ten missing cats(290 in total), but that simple task is not so simple when they are so [i]purrfect [/i]at hiding (as you already know from our games ;)). You'll have to solve numerous mechanical puzzles to open boxes, doors, roofs, holes, cars, and other weird places.

notes.title: We're making Summer Paws!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Camera improvements and Finnish translation
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

  The long awaited changes to the camera control system are here! It is now possible to rotate in place while searching for the cats and there are more customization options available. Rotating in place is by default bound to the arrow keys.

 The default controls have changed so the camera might behave differently for some of you now. Make sure to visit the options menu and tweak everything as needed if that happens.


 The game now has Finnish localization. Gigantic thanks to Heikki and Stiina Riihinen for the translation!


I hope we didn't break anything while working on those changes but if you notice any bugs please let us know here or on the forums and we will fix it ASAP. 

And if any of you wonderful people out there would like to translate the game to your language, please contact us at :  manichyenagames@gmail.com

notes.title: Hints
notes.notes:
A few of you mentioned having trouble finding the balls of yarn so we added hints. You can now click the yarn on the bottom left for a bit of help. Some of those hints will be more vague than others, so don't take them too literally. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32267428/396d36b0c25fabc2c70ebd9a2c63a73d323c4556.png[/img]

The white cat next to the yarn ball continues to offer help finding the lost cats.

And now that this is working, we're back to improving the camera.

Thank you for your support
and as always any feedback is welcome.

notes.title: First Patch and Russian translation!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

The first patch is now up! It includes a number of bug fixes and improvements to the settings, such as sensitivity sliders and V-sync support. Camera controls have also been adjusted based on feedback from our players, but work on that still continues.

We also added Russian localization. Special thanks to Алексей Февральский for providing the translation.

Thank you all for your patience and valuable feedback.

notes.title: Hidden Paws
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

My name is Rafal and this is a little game that me and my sister started developing during Christmas when we were both home. We had this idea of a little winter isle with cats hidden all over that you had to find, much like hidden object games but 3D. It took us 3 months to make, we kept adding stuff, there are now 12 isles, plus 4 tutorial ones, and over 120 little cats to find. My sister programmed it and I made the art.

I hope you like it :) and any feedback is very welcome.

Rafal
